title: Monet Journey
content: A new innovative website features the work of Claude Monet by letting you interact with his paintings.It begins by letting you topple over an inkwell. The splash turns into a series of encounters with his paintings. Discreet prompts invite you to use the mouse (or if you wish your webcam and microphone) to turn winter into spring, send a crow flying, and ripple the water.It might take a while to load unless you have a fast connection.Monet JourneyThanks, Carol!
